body.name: \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{rank}}\)
body.construction: Adapt Xie's local-linear conditional-CDF estimator to cross-fitted log-ratio responses and covariates; decompose the second stage into the oracle conditional-CDF process, indicator boundary crossings from the generated threshold, and local-design perturbations from generated conditioning arguments, then linearize the last component with the generated-covariate expansion of Mammen, Rothe, and Schienle.
